EC1: With acute diseases, such as acute phase after myocardial infarction  (within 3 months) [OR], within 3 months after acute heart failure [OR] or new cerebral infarction;
EC2: In the list of heart transplantation;
EC4: With other hemorrhagic diseases [AND] and anticoagulant therapy [AND] is not allowed;
EC6: Heart failure [OR], New York Heart Association(NYHA)  III/IV [OR] or eject fraction(EF)<40%;
EC8: Significant hepatic [OR] or renal impairment (and/or alanine transaminase(ALT) [OR] or Aspartate transaminase(AST)  >2 times upper limit of normal [OR], creatinine clearance rate(CCr)<50%);
EC9: Previous catheter radiofrequency ablation  for AF [OR] or cardiac surgery;
EC10: Pregnant and lactating women, women who plan to become pregnant, or women of child bearing age not using reliable contraceptive measures.
